entities.summary: The Parker–Hulme murder case was the murder of Honorah Mary Rieper in Christchurch, New Zealand, on 22 June 1954. The perpetrators were Rieper's teenaged daughter Pauline Parker and her friend Juliet Hulme. Parker was 16 at the time, while Hulme was 15.
